reviewMethod: Codex drafting followed by a separate agent editorial review against complete archived source; not independent legal review.

headings.title: Permitted grounds for conviction-related disqualification
headings.reviewNote: Read all four grounds including sentence execution, constitutional/code authority, other offense statute and reasonably related exercise of lawful jurisdiction.

headings.title: Convictions as relevant or impeachment evidence
headings.reviewNote: Topic wording retains the relevant-evidence or witness-impeachment context instead of a categorical claim about conviction evidence.

entries.reviewSummary: Separate Codex editorial pass against the full archived version and notes: Permitted disability grounds and evidentiary exception reviewed; second label changed from categorical assertion to relevant/impeachment-evidence topic. This is not independent legal review.

headings.title: Conditions for public-office forfeiture upon sentencing
headings.reviewNote: Forfeiture is subject to listed qualifying offenses and other statutory or constitutional grounds.

headings.title: Temporary ineligibility for public office after a felony
headings.reviewNote: Retains completion of sentence or probation and subsection3 exception; does not confuse forfeiture timing with future eligibility.

headings.title: Permanent office disqualification for voting-related felonies
headings.reviewNote: Describes felonies connected with exercising suffrage without narrowing to a named election offense or broadening to all felonies.

entries.reviewSummary: Separate Codex editorial pass against the full archived version and notes: Forfeiture label made expressly conditional; qualifying pleas and convictions, ordinary sentence/probation limit, and permanent suffrage-felony exception distinguished. This is not independent legal review.

headings.title: Proceedings permitting two-way audiovisual appearances
headings.reviewNote: Read all ten categories and varied consent/waiver requirements; not automatic permission for every proceeding.

headings.title: Other televised appearances with a presence waiver
headings.reviewNote: Preserves custody/confinement and waiver conditions without implying an entitlement.

headings.title: No right to television appearance or required equipment
headings.reviewNote: Distinguishes permission from individual right and governmental equipment obligation.

entries.reviewSummary: Separate Codex editorial pass against the full archived version and notes: Each eligible proceeding and differing consent/waiver conditions checked; other appearances and absence of statutory right/equipment obligation retained. This is not independent legal review.
